literal_meaning: ঢাকে কাঠি পড়া (drumstick falling on the drum)
figurative_meaning_en: The beginning of a ceremony or event
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকের সভায় ঢাকে কাঠি পড়ল যখন সভাপতি বক্তৃতা শুরু করলেন।
দুর্গাপূজার মঙ্গলে ঢাকে কাঠি পড়ার মতো উৎসবের শুরু হল।
example_sentences_in_english: The meeting began like the drumstick falling on the drum when the chairperson started speaking.
The festival kicked off just like the drumstick hitting the dhak during Durga Puja.
history: This idiom originates from the Bengali tradition of playing the dhak (a large drum) to signal the start of festivals and ceremonies, particularly during Durga Puja.
note: The dhak is a iconic instrument in Bengali culture, often used in processions and rituals.
